result:
I didn't resume the work, because #404 is still parked until after the 0.5 release. The owner's stop still holds. PR #436 stays a draft, and I've marked the lane blocked.

**Why the first attempt didn't finish:** it was stopped on purpose. The host started the lane from an unblock request that was withdrawn two minutes later (13:22 and 13:24 PDT). The host then parked #404 until after 0.5, because all device and lane work is pointed at that release and #404 isn't needed for it. The only thing that attempt pushed was a placeholder notes file. The harness resumed me because the PR was a draft and nothing was running, but it didn't know about the park.

**Where things stand:** the 0.5 tracking issue, #433, is still open, and #404 still has the `blocked:after-0.5` label. So I didn't write the scorer or the self-test, didn't produce the contact sheets, and didn't run the positive controls.

- **Notes:** I rewrote `docs/lanes/visual404/NOTES.md` to say why the first attempt stopped, what will unblock the lane, and where the next attempt starts. That is commit `621e87702f`, pushed.
- **Blocked comment:** I posted `[lane.visual404] blocked:` on #436. It says the lane unblocks when #433 closes or the label comes off #404.
- **Draft on purpose:** the PR only holds that notes file, so there's nothing to review or merge yet. That leaves two gaps in the definition of done. Its `Files:` line still lists the scorer and self-test, which aren't written yet. It also still says there's no prediction, which is correct: this is offline analysis with no device run.

If you want #404 done before 0.5, remove `blocked:after-0.5` from #404 and the next resume will do the full build.

The Claude Docs connector is connected, but Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Drive need authorizing in your claude.ai connector settings before they can be used here.
